method split_words(txt: string) returns (result: seq<string>)
    requires txt != null
    ensures (exists i: int :: 0 <= i < txt.Length && txt[i] == ' ' ==> result == txt.Split(' '))
    ensures (forall i: int :: 0 <= i < txt.Length && txt[i] != ' ' ==> result == txt.Split(','))
    ensures (forall i: int :: 0 <= i < txt.Length && txt[i] != ' ' && txt[i] != ',' ==> result == CountOddLowerCaseLetters(txt))
    
method CountOddLowerCaseLetters(txt: string) returns (count: int)
    requires txt != null
    ensures count >= 0
    ensures count == CountOddLowerCase(txt)
    
// Helper function to count odd lower-case letters
method CountOddLowerCase(txt: string) returns (count: int)
    requires txt != null
    ensures count >= 0
    ensures count == |{c | c in txt && 'a' <= c && c <= 'z' && (ord(c) % 2 == 1)}|
```
